questions.text: Which of the following best describes your prior experience with the C++ programming language? (This will help us provide the right level of scaffolding/enrichment in Week 1.)
options: No prior exposure: I have never written code in C++. (This is the standard starting point for the course.)
Some prior exposure: I understand basic C++ syntax (loops, variables) but have little experience with pointers, templates, or memory management.
Strong prior exposure: I am comfortable with C++ OOP, memory management, and advanced features like templates or move semantics.

questions.text: This course has CS-UH 1002 (Discrete Mathematics) as a corequisite. How confident do you feel applying mathematical logic and proof techniques (like induction) to algorithmic problems?
A major component of Week 3 and Quiz 1 is Recursion. Based on your work in CS-UH 1001 (Intro to CS), how confident are you in designing and tracing recursive functions?

options: I have never heard of Big-O notation.

I can identify basic complexities (e.g., O(n) vs O(n^2)) for simple loops.
I am comfortable performing asymptotic analysis on complex or recursive algorithms.
